inputs.text: An Indiana judge blocked a law restricting abortion after the ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice argued it burdened people’s ability to obtain abortions in line with their sincerely held religious beliefs. That matters: the state shouldn’t impose one religious or political view on everyone, especially when doing so limits people’s bodily autonomy and access to care. LifeNews.com’s “killing babies” framing turns a legal dispute over religious freedom into inflammatory rhetoric rather than engaging with the rights at stake.
